title: authz observability debrief and RBAC drift analysis
creator: Asha Patel
description: Post-incident follow-up focused on gaps in RBAC change visibility and SSO audit coverage. Goal: produce an actionable plan to tighten audit telemetry, tune SLOs/alerts for auth flows, and detect RBAC drift introduced by automation. Deliverables: (1) a prioritized list of missing audit events and log schemas, (2) alert thresholds and rationales for sign-in and admin-change SLOs, (3) a lightweight RBAC drift detector design and PoC plan, and (4) PRs and runbook updates for on-call teams.
comments: 2025-02-16: Initial reconstruction completed; root cause appears to be a combination of missing audit events for service-account role grants and overly permissive alert dedup windows during large-scale migrations.

2025-02-17: Met with SRE and IAM automation owners. Agreed to add structured audit events for role_grant, role_revoke, service_account_create, service_account_role_assign. Action: schema proposals due 2025-02-19.
2025-02-18: Draft schema posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/RBAC+Audit+Schemas. Requesting review from Observability team.

2025-02-19: Observability feedback: add request_id and kafka_partition metadata, and ensure events are emitted before RPC ACKs to avoid ordering issues. Also recommended adding a hash of policy blob for quick drift detection.

2025-02-20: Prototype RBAC drift detector spike completed. Implementation uses nightly snapshot of effective grants and a lightweight diff pipeline; PoC stores snapshots in S3 and exposes anomalies to Alertmanager via a metrics-based exporter.
2025-02-21: Security reviewed the alert plan; flagged that any new admin-change alerts must be triaged into a low-noise channel for platform-admins to avoid paging on deliberate migrations.
2025-02-21: Next: open PRs for audit-event emission (ENG-33120-audit-events) and the drift-detector PoC (ENG-33120-drift-poc). Schedule SLO baseline review with SRE for 2025-02-25 cycle.
Link to incident timeline and evidence: https://drive.redwood.ai/incident/authz-2025-02
acceptance_criteria: Structured audit events emitted for admin and service-account flows with agreed schema
Alert rules updated and verified against synthetic workload (no false positive spikes during planned migrations)
RBAC drift detector PoC runs nightly and surfaces at least one verified historical drift case in the next 7 days
Runbook updated with triage steps and owner assignments; security sign-off obtained
